description: This file defines the LDAPUser class, which models a user retrieved from LDAP directory, including attributes like DN, username, email, and related LDAP search settings. It includes validation and utility functions relevant to LDAP user data handling within the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: LDAPUser
classes.description: Represents an LDAP directory user with attributes and validation methods, integrating LDAP search settings and handling LDAP entries within OrangeHRM.

methods.name: getUserDN
methods.description: Returns the distinguished name (DN) of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setUserDN
methods.description: Sets the distinguished name (DN) of the LDAP user, validating its length.

methods.name: getUsername
methods.description: Returns the username of the LDAP user.

methods.name: setUsername
methods.description: Sets the username, validating its length according to system constraints.

methods.name: getUserUniqueId
methods.description: Returns the unique identifier of the LDAP user, if set.

methods.name: setUserUniqueId
methods.description: Sets the user’s unique ID, with length validation and logging if exceeded.

methods.name: isUserEnabled
methods.description: Indicates whether the LDAP user is enabled.

methods.name: setUserEnabled
methods.description: Sets the enabled status of the LDAP user.

methods.name: getFirstName
methods.description: Returns the user's first name.

methods.name: setFirstName
methods.description: Sets the first name of the user, validating max length.

methods.name: getMiddleName
methods.description: Returns the user's middle name.

methods.name: setMiddleName
methods.description: Sets the middle name, validating max length.

methods.name: getLastName
methods.description: Returns the user's last name.

methods.name: setLastName
methods.description: Sets the last name, validating max length.

methods.name: getEmployeeId
methods.description: Returns the employee ID, if available.

methods.name: setEmployeeId
methods.description: Sets the employee ID with length validation.

methods.name: getWorkEmail
methods.description: Returns the work email, if available.

methods.name: setWorkEmail
methods.description: Sets the work email, validating format and length.

methods.name: setUserLookupSetting
methods.description: Associates LDAPUser with LDAP search/lookup settings.

methods.name: setEntry
methods.description: Associates an LDAP Entry object with this user.

methods.name: getEmployeeSearchFilterParams
methods.description: Retrieves search filter parameters based on LDAP entry and lookup settings.

methods.name: getLogInfo
methods.description: Provides logging information for the LDAP entry.
